name: agentic-hub
description: Claude Code marketplace for agentic-hub provider-agnostic plugins

plugins.name: jev
plugins.description: System 1 pre-flight routing, free-tier offloading, model ceiling guard and quality gates via TypeSafe Jev

plugins.name: local-transcribe
plugins.description: Local speech transcription and call recording pipeline with whisper

plugins.name: chrome-devtools
plugins.description: Chrome browser automation and DevTools Protocol bridge

plugins.name: memory
plugins.description: Unified session memory umbrella wrapping Recall and Lookup with offline local caching

plugins.name: gitea
plugins.description: Gitea repository inspection, issue reading, and commit inspection

plugins.name: google-workspace
plugins.description: Google Workspace integration: Gmail and Google Calendar

plugins.name: subagents
plugins.description: Specialized engineering, testing, and operations subagents

plugins.name: clarify
plugins.description: Walk a non-trivial design through its forks one question at a time, with trade-offs and explicit recommendations. Also /grill-me.

plugins.name: cplain
plugins.description: Plain-English variant of clarify: no jargon, intuitive mental models. Use via /cplain.

plugins.name: celi5
plugins.description: Explain-like-I'm-five variant of clarify, with everyday analogies. Use via /celi5.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Keep a project's living HANDOFF.md (state, decisions and rejected options, deferred branches, next actions) so a new session can continue without the original conversation. Use via /handoff.

plugins.name: markdown-convert
plugins.description: Convert PDFs, Office documents and .eml emails into Markdown sidecar files, with offline OCR fallback for scanned PDFs.

plugins.name: mcp-toggle
plugins.description: Inspect and toggle on-demand MCP server plugins (Chrome DevTools, Google Workspace, Jev) to save context tokens.

plugins.name: md-to-pdf
plugins.description: Convert Markdown documents to professionally styled PDFs using HTML/CSS templates and WeasyPrint.

plugins.name: rclone-cloud-storage
plugins.description: Manage Google Drive, OneDrive and other cloud storage with rclone.

plugins.name: skills-doctor
plugins.description: Diagnose and repair npx skills installs across project and global scopes.

plugins.name: sync-main
plugins.description: Merge the latest main into the current branch, then build, test and lint with failure attribution. Never pushes on its own.
